title: OPS — /gate: exclude dry-run posts from all gate metrics
summary: Fixed cmdGate() in cmd-gate.ts to use readRealPosts() throughout. Replaced all manualPostsPath readFileSync calls (postedIds, last post time, stale views warning, last 7d pace, weekday bar, cadence gap, this-week on-track, best post) with realPosts array. Removed now-unused manualPostsPath variable.
root_cause: cmdGate() read manual-posts.jsonl directly without filtering dry-run entries, inflating post count, views, and pace metrics.
fix: Use readRealPosts() for all post data in cmdGate(). 7 separate readFileSync calls replaced. manualPostsPath variable removed.
